title: 1 in 4 AI Skills Has a Security Risk and Some Were Built to Attack You.
description:
One in every four AI skills you can download right now has a security hole, and one in twenty shows signs it was built to attack you. That's from a real study: 26.1 percent of published AI skills contain vulnerabilities, 5.2 percent show likely malicious intent. And if you follow this page, you've been installing skills into Claude Code for weeks.

So NVIDIA built SkillSpector and released it free this week. It's an open-source scanner for AI skills: point it at any skill, repo, zip file, folder or single file, and it checks 68 attack patterns across 17 categories, prompt injection, data leaks, privilege escalation, supply-chain tricks, then returns a risk score out of 100. Fast static scan by default, with an optional AI pass that reads the skill's intent. Works with Claude Code, Codex and MCP skills.

Honest part: I've sent you a dozen skills from this page myself. Scan those too. A clean score is a strong signal, not a guarantee.

Comment SCAN and I'll send you the link.

#ai #claude #claudecode #nvidia #cybersecurity
